mentions.name: Appio.so
mentions.description: This service lets web apps add mobile widgets and native push notifications within minutes, without building or maintaining native mobile apps, hiring developers, or dealing with app stores.
mentions.problem: Web apps normally require building and maintaining native mobile apps, hiring developers, and dealing with app stores to offer mobile widgets and push notifications.
mentions.audience: Founders and developers building web-based products without a mobile app
mentions.source_excerpt: Appio lets you add mobile widgets and native push notifications to your web app within minutes, without building or maintaining mobile apps, hiring developers, or dealing with app stores.

evidence.value: Appio lets you add mobile widgets and native push notifications to your web app within minutes, without building or maintaining mobile apps, hiring developers, or dealing with app stores.
